paragraphs: Rav Chaviva bar Surmaki, chapter Hasokher, Bava Metzia 85b, in Rav Chaviva’s time (see Rabbi Chiyya the Great). When he went up to the Land, he stated what Rabbah bar Ulla had questioned: Yoma 6a. Ein Yaakov reads,“When Rabbi Abba went up, he stated what ….”Perhaps Yuchasin’s reading was “Rabbi Abba bar Surmaki, when he went up”; therefore he wrote Abba bar Surmaki (see his entry).
